title: USPS Change of Address Forward Days Leaderboard
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=usps:change forward_days=*
| stats sum(forward_days) as total_value, avg(forward_days) as avg_value by move_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks move type values by total and average forward days across USPS change of address events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `forward_days` values for each USPS change of address event and review total and average forward days by move type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total forward days.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which move type shows the biggest forward days numbers in your USPS change of address data.
